items.claim: 2030 長期營收成長率模型 12–14%，高於前一版模型
items.quote: you get to about a 12% to 14% growth rate for the company
items.speaker: Thad Trent

items.claim: 前一版長期成長模型為 10–12%，本次上調，主因 AI 資料中心
items.quote: Previous model was 10% to 12%, so we're taking that up
items.speaker: Thad Trent

items.claim: 以 2026 年 Street 共識為基礎，2030 年營收略低於 110 億美元
items.quote: just under $11 billion of revenue in 2030
items.speaker: Thad Trent

items.claim: 數字口徑：模型的 2026 基期是 Street 共識，不是公司自己的預估
items.quote: It's not our estimates, it's actually your estimates.
items.speaker: Thad Trent

items.claim: 數字口徑：長期模型假設 SAAR 持平，SAAR 上升為額外順風
items.quote: we're assuming a 0 SAAR
items.speaker: Thad Trent

items.claim: AI 資料中心 2030 年目標：長期成長至少高於市場 10 個百分點
items.quote: we are going to grow at least 10% above the market
items.speaker: Achyut Shah

items.claim: 舉例：市場 CAGR 40% 時，AIDC 營收由 2026 年 5 億美元基期成長至 2030 年逾 25 億美元
items.quote: we will deliver over $2.5 billion of revenue just in 2030
items.speaker: Achyut Shah

items.claim: 2026 年 AI 資料中心業務預計成長逾一倍
items.quote: more than double the AI data center part of our business
items.speaker: Achyut Shah

items.claim: 對 2027 年 AI 資料中心業務再翻倍表示有能見度
items.quote: this business is going to double again
items.speaker: Achyut Shah

items.claim: 車用 2026–2030 年營收成長約 9%/年，假設 SAAR 持平
items.quote: we'll grow our automotive revenue at about 9% a year
items.speaker: Sudhir Gopalswamy

items.claim: 工業市場長期成長目標 10%
items.quote: allow us to grow by 10% in the industrial market
items.speaker: Sudhir Gopalswamy

items.claim: 自由現金流率目標由 25–30% 上調至 30–35%
items.quote: Our target is going to 30% to 35%.
items.speaker: Thad Trent

items.claim: 2026 年 Street 共識自由現金流約 16 億美元
items.quote: about $1.6 billion in free cash flow for 2026
items.speaker: Thad Trent

items.claim: Synaptics 獨立計畫：成長率高於 15%，毛利率高於 55%
items.quote: We're looking at margins higher than 55%
items.speaker: Thad Trent

items.claim: Synaptics 前 18 個月協同效益 2 億美元，已含股權報酬
items.quote: $200 million of synergies in this number
items.speaker: Thad Trent

items.claim: 數字口徑：長期模型為 onsemi 獨立數字，不含 Synaptics；預期明年完成交易
items.quote: It has nothing to do with Synaptics.
items.speaker: Thad Trent

items.claim: 毛利率目標維持 53%，未上調
items.quote: our target remains 53%
items.speaker: Thad Trent

items.claim: 管理層把 53% 定位為里程碑，達成後再談更高
items.quote: The 53% is a milestone. It's not a destination.
items.speaker: Thad Trent

items.claim: 毛利率拆解：稼動率貢獻 650 bp
items.quote: you've got utilization, 650 basis points.
items.speaker: Thad Trent

items.claim: 稼動率口徑：去年底 68%，2026 Q2 約 83%
items.quote: exited last year at 68%. We're roughly around 83% in Q2
items.speaker: Thad Trent

items.claim: 毛利率拆解：Fab Right 貢獻 225 bp，比以往說法更高，納入已宣布的出售
items.quote: On the Fab Right, 225 basis points.
items.speaker: Thad Trent

items.claim: Fab Right 225 bp 中已有 50 bp 確定，其餘約 18–24 個月內認列
items.quote: Now 50 of that is already in the bag.
items.speaker: Thad Trent

items.claim: 營收成長 12–14% 搭配 53% 毛利率下，毛利金額成長 22%
items.quote: gross profit dollars are going to grow by 22%
items.speaker: Thad Trent

items.claim: 營業利益成長速度為營收的兩倍
items.quote: Operating income is going to grow 2x revenue.
items.speaker: Thad Trent

items.claim: 2030 模型營業利益率 38%
items.quote: You get to an operating margin of 38%
items.speaker: Thad Trent

items.claim: 漲價進入第二輪，用來抵銷已發生的投入成本
items.quote: We're raising pricing with our customers
items.speaker: Thad Trent

items.claim: 投入成本逆風已先出現在毛利率，漲價效益尚未跟上
items.quote: headwind of the input cost hitting the margin line already

items.claim: 答分析師：毛利率路徑建議以線性建模，市場快則可更快
items.quote: I would think about a pretty linear progression.

items.quote: the current cost structure is 17% lower

items.claim: 資本支出強度維持約 5%，擴產在既有廠區內
items.quote: We can do this at about a 5% capital intensity.

items.claim: 上述期間股數減少 12%
items.quote: we've reduced our share count by 12% during that time
items.speaker: Thad Trent

items.claim: 現有買回授權尚餘 53 億美元
items.quote: We've got $5.3 billion left on our existing authorization.
items.speaker: Thad Trent

items.claim: 股東回饋計畫：扣除其他投資後，自由現金流 100% 回饋股東
items.quote: 100% free cash flow back to shareholders
items.speaker: Thad Trent

items.claim: 過去 5 年投入 87 億美元，換得約 810 億美元 TAM 擴張
items.quote: $8.7 billion for an $81 billion TAM expansion
items.speaker: Thad Trent

items.claim: 約 65% 產品仍由外部代工，晶圓廠網路已整併
items.quote: we'll be manufacturing about 65% externally
items.speaker: Thad Trent

items.claim: 承諾預測期間不再增加 brownfield 產能投資
items.quote: there won't be additional brownfield investment
items.speaker: Thad Trent

items.claim: 9 億美元非核心業務退出已全部完成
items.quote: the exits are now done and behind us
items.speaker: Thad Trent

items.claim: EPP 量產無須增加資本支出，併入 5% 基線
items.quote: there is no incremental investment.

items.claim: 車用 SiC 下一代將於約兩個月內發表，性能每代提升 25% 以上
items.quote: increase by 25% or even more by generation
items.speaker: Sudhir Gopalswamy

items.claim: 管理層表示打算與客戶分享所創造的價值
items.quote: we intend to share that value that we create
items.speaker: Sudhir Gopalswamy

items.claim: 宣布今年贏得主要 Vcore 插槽，營收 2026 年底起認列
items.quote: we won a major Vcore socket this year
items.speaker: Achyut Shah

items.claim: 每機櫃 onsemi 內容價值由約 1.5 萬美元提升至逾 11.5 萬美元
items.quote: about $15,000 a rack to over $115,000
items.speaker: Achyut Shah

items.claim: sidecar 架構 800V 機櫃預計約 12–18 個月內（2027 年底）開始放量
items.quote: start ramping in the next 12 to 18 months
items.speaker: Achyut Shah

items.claim: 固態變壓器世代預計 2028 年底至 2029 年初開始
items.quote: sometime in the end of '28, early '29
items.speaker: Achyut Shah

items.claim: 車用乙太網路 10BASE-T1S 區域架構首個車用新客戶量產預計今年底開始
items.quote: ramp starting actually at the end of this year
items.speaker: Hassane El-Khoury

items.claim: 車用每車 onsemi 內容機會最高 2,000 美元
items.quote: up to $2,000 of onsemi content per vehicle
items.speaker: Sudhir Gopalswamy

items.claim: 實體 AI（不含車用）2030 年對公司 TAM 約 60 億美元
items.quote: represents a $6 billion TAM for us by 2030
items.speaker: Sudhir Gopalswamy

items.claim: AI 電力樹由格點到核心全覆蓋者只剩兩家
items.quote: left with just 2 companies onsemi and one more
items.speaker: Achyut Shah

items.claim: 高壓中段（SiC／GaN）具備規模的競爭者僅 3–4 家
items.quote: there's just a handful, 3 or 4 competitors
items.speaker: Achyut Shah

items.claim: 管理層稱垂直 GaN 領先最接近的競爭者約五年
items.quote: half a decade ahead from the closest competitor
items.speaker: Hassane El-Khoury

items.claim: 管理層稱 EPP 的優勢是熱與機構面，不只是電氣面
items.quote: is not electrical. It's thermal and mechanical.

items.claim: 管理層承認在 Vcore 較晚進入市場，稱已追上
items.quote: we came a little later to the market

items.quote: there is always a concern when it comes to a new market

items.quote: The 800-volt is not going to go flip the switch

items.quote: No 10% customer and our top 20 customers are 35% of revenue.

items.claim: 客戶總數約 9,000 家
items.quote: We have 9,000 customers around the globe.

items.claim: 管理層稱與所有主要資料中心客戶深度綁定
items.quote: we are deeply embedded with all of these customers
